searchText: Why does the template (and thus all EIPs) skip the first level of nesting and go straight to `##`? I wonder if it would be worthwhile to do a one-time mass change to correctly start with `#`. While it is not technically illegal to skip a level of nesting in markdown, it feels like bad form. <@!301186049323958275> I'll leave comments/affirmations that I've checked certain EIPs now. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3085: It says it can be merged now. Was the only problem the inability to previously merge because of a CI issue? https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3065 - Merged. Left comment. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3023#pullrequestreview-526007841: Left comment and correction to the EIP. Didn't merge. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/2995: Left comment, didn't merge. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/2920: Left comment. Sorry for the delay. I recommend merging any that you think are worthy of being merged, I am unlikely to merge them unless your comments are incredibly compelling. 🙂 3085 was an EIP number squatting issue but the author went with the number I suggested. Only reason I haven't merged it now is because something with GitHub is broken. Oh got it. I will merge that one, and wait a few days for the others to both give authors a chance to rebut and other editors to chime in. Actually, looks like GitHub is fixed, merging that one now. Cool! Thanks for taking the time to go over them! No prob! Hit me up next time this happens. I need nudging to get on it 🙂
